svg.aria-label: Scenario 8, where your other plugins fit. Operator's setup: concrete tool and plugin names are project-overlay matters, not part of the canonical specs. You ask: Where do my other plugins fit? The two lanes: Lane 1, code and experiment: /research-mentor discuss, /math-reviewer verify theory, /dl-engineer implement, regression-guardian gate, experiment-runner run, /results-analyst analyze, repo-maintainer commit. superpowers attaches to the implement step: brainstorming, plan mode, approval, execution, before any build. Lane 2, paper: /research-mentor discuss research, /results-analyst pull numbers and figures, /paper-writer write, revise and compile, /math-reviewer verify equations, tools/anonymize.py anonymize, blind-reviewer independent critique, /paper-writer revise again, repo-maintainer commit. ARS deep-research attaches to every research-mentor step; ARS academic-paper attaches to every paper-writer step. In your session, one shared context: the superpowers 7.0.0 skills as their files state them: superpowers:brainstorming — nothing gets built until your human partner approves the full description, with two exceptions, you opted out of the questions, or a spike you said yes to, which stays labeled throwaway, and keeping what it produced comes back through this gate; after a project's document is approved, the next step is the plan: superpowers:writing-plans, bite-sized tasks, before touching code; you review the plan before implementation and choose the execution method, unless you already gave one: if subagent-driven, superpowers:subagent-driven-development, a fresh implementer subagent per task, a task review after each, a whole-branch review at the end, its findings get one fix wave, there is no second fix wave; or if native, superpowers:executing-plans, the session implements task by task itself, one fresh-context review of the whole branch at the end. ARS 3.23.1 deep-research, lit-review and fact-check modes, systematic literature search and source verification, feeds the literature verification of /research-master:research-mentor, which drafts each literature finding as a LITERATURE_MAP.md entry with verified how, on, by, filled honestly; claims that could not be verified are listed as such, never silently asserted. ARS academic-paper, outline and citation-check modes, a detailed outline and evidence map and a citation error report, feeds the prose of /research-master:paper-writer, which returns revised sources and a build report after every edit and never invents a number or re-inflates a downgraded claim. ARS academic-paper-reviewer is the rehearsal panel in the same context: a five-seat, role-separated review panel whose roles run inline in the main session by default; role separation is not a claim of independent error processes; its iron rule: do not call persona separation independence. The draft goes through tools/anonymize.py; only the anonymized bundle and the target venue cross the context boundary. Dispatched, isolated context: dispatch blind-reviewer, the review of record, isolated: exactly one input, the anonymized bundle plus the target venue; it returns one complete referee report, which comes back through you to /paper-writer to revise again; anything else offered is declined; it never accepts project context. Isolated roles get a fresh context, see only their dispatch prompt and its inputs, and return one report. Choose by asking: does this role's value come from sharing the operator's context, or from not sharing it? Footnote: ARS says role separation is not a claim of independent error processes; research-master's rule: the author never certifies their own work, and the reviewer of record never shares the author's context.
svg.title: Scenario 8 — where your other plugins fit
svg.desc: The two lanes with the outside skills attached where the sources put them: superpowers on Lane 1's implement step, before any build; ARS deep-research feeding research-mentor's literature verification; ARS academic-paper feeding paper-writer's prose; ARS academic-paper-reviewer as a rehearsal panel in your session, and blind-reviewer as the isolated review of record across the context boundary.
